job.question: What contract term, including any extension options, does the Los Angeles Fire and Police Pensions (LAFPP) RFP for financial statement audit services contemplate?
job.expected_facts: A three-year contract (fiscal years ending June 30, 2025, 2026 and 2027) with a maximum fee proposal for each fiscal year; the Board may extend beyond the three-year term through two one-year renewals.
job.acceptance: Three years plus two optional one-year renewals, up to five years, suffices. Fiscal-year dates and fee-proposal details are optional.

reviews.reason: This is an Indiana Public Retirement System (INPRS) audit-services RFP, not an LAFPP RFP. Its stated term is an initial five years with possible renewals, rather than three years plus two optional one-year renewals.
quotes: Request for Proposals (“RFP”) for Audit Services for the Indiana Public Retirement System (“INPRS” or the “System”)
The term of the contract entered into under this RFP shall be for an initial period of five (5) years, beginning from the date of final execution of contract.
There may be one (1) or more renewals under the same terms and conditions at INPRS’s option up to the length of the original term.
